# cmcqueen/cobs-c

The files `cobs.c` and `cobs.h` are the ordinary COBS implementation vendored
from [cmcqueen/cobs-c](https://github.com/cmcqueen/cobs-c) at commit
`7afcc42cf7a7efa84f77360ec27bfc979e3cf93d`.

Copyright (c) 2010 Craig McQueen and distributed under the MIT licence in
`LICENSE.txt`. The COBS/R implementation and upstream tests/build files are not
vendored. The function symbols are locally prefixed to keep the third-party API
private to the Transport implementation.
